G3700.def:
ὀπτάνω
[in LXX: 3Ki.8:8 (רָאָה ni.), Tob.12:19 * ;]
late present as from ὤφθην (= ὁράω); mid., ὀπτάνομαι, to allow oneself to be seen, to appear. with dative, At 1:3. (For exx. from π., see Deiss., LAE, 79, 2526; MM, ii, xviii.) †
(AS)

G3701.def:
ὀπτασία, -ας, ἡ
(ὀπτάζομαι, Nm 14:14* = ὀπτάνομαι), later form of ὄψις, [in LXX: Ml 3:2 (רָאָה ni.), Da TH Dn 9:23 10:1, 7-8 10:16 (מַרְאֶה, מַרְאָה LXX, ὅραμα, -σις), Et 4:7, Sir.43:2, 16 * ;]
__1. an appearing, coming into view (Ma, Es, Sir, ll. with).
__2. a vision: Lc 1:22 24:23, At 26:19, 2Co 12:1 (Da, ll. with, also in MGr.).†
(AS)

G3703.def:
ὀπώρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Jr 48:32 40:10, 12 (קַיִץ) * ;]
__1. late summer, early autumn (the time between the risings of Sirius and Arcturus, i.e. late July, all August and early September).
__2. By meton. (as being fruit-time), ripe fruits Ap 18:14 (cf. φθινοπωρινά, Ju 12).†
(AS)

G3704.def:
ὅπως
__I. Relat. adv. of manner, as, how: with indic., Lc 24:20.
__II. Conj., with subjc. (in cl. also with opt., indic.: so in Mt 26:59, LT, Tr.), in order that, to the end that, that;
__1. final, denoting purpose or design (in which the original idea of modality has been merged): after pres., Mt 6:2, al.; pf., At 9:17, al.; impf., At 9:24; aor., At 9:2, al.; plpf., Jo 11:57; fut., Mt 23:35; imperat., Mt 2:8, al.; ὅ. μή (M, Pr., 185), Mt 6:18, Lc 16:26, At 20:16, 1Co 1:29; ὅ. πληρωθῇ, Mt 2:23 8:17 13:35; ὅ. ἄν (B1., § 65, 2; WM, § 42, 5), Lc 2:35, At 3:19 15:17, Rm 3:4 (cf. Gn 12:13, Sl 59:7. 1Mac 1032, al.).
__2. After verbs of asking, exhorting, etc.: Mt 9:38, Lc 7:3, Tg 5:16, al. (in late writers its place is often taken by the correl. πῶς, which see)
(AS)

G3705.def:
ὅραμα, -τος, τό
(ὁράω), [in LXX for חָזוֹן, מַרְאֶה, etc. ;]
that which is seen;
__(a) a sight, spectacle: Mt 17:9, At 7:31;
__(b) an appearance, vision: At 9:10, 12 (Rec.) At 10:3, 17 10:19 11:5 12:9 16:9-10 18:9 (cf. ὀπτασία).†
(AS)

G3706.def:
ὅρασις, -εως, ἡ
(ὁράω) [in LXX chiefly for מַרְאֶה, חָזוֹן and cognate forms ;]
__1. in Arist. and later writers, the act of seeing, the sense of sight, and by meton., pl., the eyes.
__2. appearance (Nm 24:4, Eze.1:5, Sir.41:20, al.): Ap 4:3.
__3. = ὅραμα, a vision: At 2:17 (LXX), Ap 9:17.†
(AS)

G3708G.def:
ὁράω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for ראה, also for חזה, etc. ;] in "durative" sense (hence aor. act., εἶδον, pass., ὤφθην, fut., ὄψομαι, from different roots; see M, Pr., 110f.), to see (in colloq. even the present is rare, its place being generally taken by θεωρέω, see BL, §24).
__1. Of bodily vision, to see, perceive, behold: absol., Mc 6:38, al.; ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε, Jo 1:46, al.; before ὅτι, Mc 2:16, al.; with accusative, Mt 2:2, Mc 1:10 16:7, Gl 1:19, al.; θεόν, Jo 1:18, 1Jo 4:20, al.
__2. to see with the mind, perceive, discern: absol, Rm 15:21; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 9:2 27:54, At 8:23, Cl 2:18, al.
__3. to see, take heed, beware: ὅρα μή, with aor. subjc., Mt 8:4 18:10, Mc 1:44, 1Ts 5:15; id., sc. μὴ ποήσῃς, Ap 19:10 22:9 (Bl., §81, 1); before imperat. Mt 9:30 16:6, Mc 8:15
__4. to experience: τ. θάνατον, Lc 2:26, Hb 11:5; ζωήν, Jo 3:36; τ. διαφθοράν, At 2:27.
__5. to visit: with accusative of person(s), Lc 8:20, Jo 12:21, Rm 1:11, al.; with accusative loc, At 19:21.
__6. to see to, care for: Mt 27:4, At 18:15 (cf. ἀφ-, καθ-, προ-, συν-οράω).
SYN.: see: βλέπω. (AS)

G3709.def:
ὀργή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אַף, also for חָרוֹן, חֵמָה, קָצַף, etc. ;]
__1 1, impulse, propensity, disposition.
__2. anger, wrath;
__(a) of men: Mc 3:5, Ef 4:31, Cl 3:8, 1Tm 2:8, Tg 1:19-20;
__(b) of God;
__α that reaction of the divine nature against sin which in anthropomorphic language is called anger: Rm 1:18 9:22 12:19, (ICC, in l), 1Ts 1:10 2:16, Hb 3:11 4:3" (LXX) Ap 14:10 16:19 19:15;
__β of the effect of God's anger: Mt 3:7, Lc 3:7 21:23, Jo 3:36, Rm 2:5, 8 3:5 4:15 5:9 13:4-5 Ef 5:6, Cl 3:6, 1Ts 5:9, Tg 1:20, Ap 6:16-17 11:18; σκεύη ὀργῆς, Rm 9:22; τέκνα ὀργῆς, Ef 2:3.†
SYN.: see: θυμός (AS)

G3710.def:
ὀργίζω
(ὀργή), [in LXX chiefly for חָרָה, also for קָצַף, etc. ;]
to make angry, provoke to anger; in cl. most frequently in pass., and so always in NT, to be provoked to anger, be angry: absol., Mt 18:34 22:7, Lc 14:21 15:28, Ef 4:26" (LXX), Ap 11:18; with dative, Mt 5:22; before ἐπί, with dative (3Ki.11:9, al.), Ap 12:17 (cf. παρ-ὀργίζω).†
(AS)

G3711.def:
ὀργίλος, -η, -ον
(ὀργή), [in LXX: Pv 22:24 29:22 (חֵמָה), etc. ;]
inclined to anger, passionate: Tt 1:7.†
(AS)

G3712.def:
ὀργυιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(ὀρέγω),
the length of the outstretched arms, a fathom: At 27:28.†
(AS)

G3713.def:
ὀρέγω
[in Sm.: Jó 8:20, Eze.16:49 * ;]
to reach, stretch out; pass. and mid., to stretch oneself out, reach forth; metaphorically, to reach after, grasp at, aspire to: with genitive of thing(s), 1Tm 3:1, Hb 11:16; φιλαργυρίας (see Ellic. and CGT, in l), 1Tm 6:10.†
SYN.: ἐπιθυμέω, to desire (which see) (AS)

G3714.def:
ὀρεινός (WH, ὀριν-; see MM, xviii,) -ή, -όν
(ὄρος),
mountainous, hilly; ἡ ὀ. (sc. χώρα), the hill-country (LXX for הַר): Lc 1:39, 65 †
(AS)

G3715.def:
ὄρεξις, -εως, ἡ
(ὀρέγομαι), [in LXX Wis.14:2 15:5 16:2-3, Sir.18:30 23:6, 4Ma.1:33 4Mac 1:35 * ;]
the most general ward for all kinds of desire, longing, appetite: of lust, Rm 1:27
SYN.: see: πάθος (AS)

G3716.def:
ὀρθοποδέω, -ῶ
(ὀρθό-πους, going straight),
= cl. εὐθυπορέω, to walk straight: metaphorically, Gl 2:14 (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G3717.def:
ὀρθός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for יָשָׁר ;]
straight;
__(a) in height, straight, upright: At 14:10;
__(b) in line, straight, direct: figuratively, Hb 12:13 (LXX).†
(AS)

G3718.def:
ὀρθοτομέω, -ῶ
(- ὀρθός, τέμνω), [in LXX: Pv 3:6 11:6 (יָשַׁר pi.)* ;]
to cut straight, as a road (τ. ὁδούς, figuratively, Pr, ll with). Metaphorical, τ. λόγον τ. ἀληθείας, 2Tm 2:15 (V. Ellic. and CGT, in l; not found elsewhere).†
(AS)

G3719.def:
ὀρθρίζω
(ὄρθρος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַם hi., Gn 19:2, al.; also for שָׁחַר pi., Sl 63:1, al., etc. ;]
= cl. poët., ὀρθρεύω, to rise early: before πρός, with accusative of person(s) (as Ps, l.with, al.), Lc 21:38 (see Thumb, Hellen., 123).†
(AS)

G3720.def:
ὀρθρινός, -ή, -όν
(ὄρθρος), [in LXX: Os 6:4 13:3 (שָׁכַם hi.), Ag 2:14, Wis.11:22 * ;]
late form of ὄρθριος (which see), early: Lc 24:22.†
(AS)

G3722.def:
ὄρθρος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for שַׁחַר, בֹּקֶר, etc. ;]
daybreak, dawn: ὄρθρου βαθέως (M, Pr., 73), at early dawn, Lc 24:1; ὄρθρου, Jo 8:2; ὑπὸ τὸν ὄ., At 5:21 (cf. MM, xviii).†
(AS)

G3724.def:
ὁρίζω
(ὅρος, a boundary), [in LXX for אָסַר, גְּבוּל, etc. ;]
__1. to separate, mark off by boundaries (so Nm 34:6, Jo 13:27).
__2. to determine, appoint, designate: of time, with accusative, At 17:26, Hb 4:7; with accusative of person(s), At 17:31; with inf., At 11:29; pass., Lc 22:22, At 2:23 10:42, Rm 1:4 (cf. ὀφ-, ἀπο- δι-, τρο-ορίζω),†
(AS)

G3725.def:
ὅριον, -ου, τό
(ὅρος, a boundary), [in LXX chiefly for גְּבוּל ;]
a boundary, bound; chiefly in pl., and so always in NT: Mt 2:16 4:13 8:34 15:22, 39 19:1, Mc 5:17 7:24, 31 10:1, At 13:50.†
(AS)

G3726.def:
ὁρκίζω
(ὅρκος), [in LXX: Gn 24:37, al. (שָׁבַע hi.) ;]
__1. to make one swear (Xen., Polyb., a1.).
__2. to adjure: with dupl. accusative, Mc 5:7, At 19:13 (cf. ἐν-, ἐξ-ορκίζω).†
(AS)

G3727.def:
ὅρκος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁוַע, שִׁבְעָה and cogn. forms ;]
an oath: Mt 14:7 26:72, Lc 1:73, At 2:30, Hb 6:16-17, Tg 5:12; p1., Mt 5:33 (LXX) Mt 14:9, Mc 6:26.†
(AS)

G3728.def:
ὁρκωμοσία, -ας, ἡ
(ὅρκος, ὄμνυμι; by metapl. for τὰ ὁρκωμόσια, asseverations on oath; see MM, xviii), [in LXX: Eze.17:18-19 (עָלָה) 1Es 9:93* ;]
affirmation on oath, an oath: Hb 7:20-21, 28.†
(AS)

G3729.def:
ὁρμάω, -ῶ
(ὁρμή), [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;]
__1. causal, to set in motion, urge on.
__2. Intrans., to hasten on, rush: before εἰς, Mt 8:32, Mc 5:13, Lc 8:33, At 19:29; ἐπί, with accusative, At 7:57.†
(AS)

G3730.def:
ὁρμή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Pv 3:25 (שׁוֹא), etc. ;]
__1. a violent movement, impulse: Tg 3:4;
__2. a hostile movement, onset, assault. At 14:5.†
(AS)

G3731.def:
ὅρμημα, -τος, τό
(ὁρμάω) [in LXX: Os 5:10, Am 1:11 (עֶבְרָה), etc. ;]
a rush: Ap 18:21.†
(AS)

G3732.def:
ὄρνεον, -ου, τό = ὄρνις,
[in LXX chiefly for צִפּוֹר ;]
a bird: Ap 18:2 19:17, 21 (Hom., al.).†
(AS)

G3733.def:
ὄρνις, -ιθος, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX: ὄ. ἐκλεκταί, I2Ki.3:1 4:23 (3Ki.5:3) (בַּרְבֻּר)* ;]
a bird; specif., a cock, a hen: Mt 23:3, Lc 13:34 (WH).†
(AS)

G3734.def:
ὁροθεσία, -ας, ἡ
(ὅρος, a boundary, + τίθημι)
a setting of boundaries; in pl., bounds; At 17:26.†
(AS)

G3735.def:
ὄρος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly, and very freq., for הַר ;]
a mountain: Mt 4:8 17:1, Mc 9:2, Jo 4:20, 2Pe 1:18, al.; opposite to βουνός, Lc 3:5 (LXX); ὄ. τ. ἐλαιῶν, Mt 21:1 24:3, al. (see: ἐ.); ὄ. Σιών (Σ., prob. in gem appos.), Hb 12:22, Ap 14:1; ὄ. Σινά, At 7:30, 38 Gl 4:24-25; τὸ ὄ., of the hill district as distinct from the lowlands, esp. the hills above the Sea of Galilee, Mt 5:1 8:1, Mc 3:13 6:46, al.; τὰ ὄ., Mt 18:12, Mc 5:5, Hb 11:38, Ap 6:14, al.; proverbially (cf. Rabbinic, הדים עקר), of overcoming difficulties, accomplishing marvels, ὄρη μεθιστάνειν, 1Co 13:2, cf. Mt 17:20 21:21, Mc 11:23
(AS)

G3736.def:
ὀρύσσω
[in LXX chiefly for חָפַר also for כָּרָה, etc. ;]
to dig: with accusative, ληνόν, Mt 21:33; ὁπολήνιον, Mc 12:1; γῆν, Mt 25:18 (cf. δι-, ἐξ-ορύσσω).†
(AS)

G3737.def:
ὀρφανός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for יָתוֹם ;]
__1. prop., orphan, fatherless: Mc 12:40, WH, mg, Tg 1:27.
__2. In a general sense (as also in cl.; see LS, see word; and cf. MM, xviii), bereft, friendless, desolate: Jo 14:18.†
(AS)

G3738.def:
ὀρχέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX for רָקַד, etc. ;]
to dance; Mt 11:17 14:6, Mc 6:22, Lc 7:32.†
(AS)

G3739.def:
ὅς, ἥ, ὅ,
the postpositive article (ἄρθρον ὑποτακτικόν).
__I. As demonstr. pron. = οὗτος, ὅδε, this, that, also for αὐτός, chiefly in nom.: ὅς δέ, but he (cf. ἦ δὲ ὅς, frequently in Plat.), Mc 15:23, Jo 5:11; ὃς μὲν . . . ὃς δέ, the one . . . the other, Mt 21:35, 22:5, 25:15, Lc 23:33, At 27:14, Rm 14:5, 1Co 11:21, 2Co 2:18, Ju 22; neut., ὃ μὲν . . . ὃ δέ, the one . . . the other, some . . . some, Mt 13:8, 23, Rm 9:21; ὃς (ὃ) μὲν . . . (ἄλλος (ἄλλο)) . . . ἕτερος, Mc 4:4, Lc 8:5, 1Co 12:8-10; οὓς μέν, absol., 1Co 12:28; ὃς μὲν . . . ὁ δέ, Rm 14:2.
__II. As relat. pron., who, which, what, that;
__1. agreeing in gender with its antecedent, but differently governed as to case: Mt 2:9, Lc 9:9, At 20:18, Rm 2:29, al. mult.
__2. In variation from the common construction;
__(a) in gender, agreeing with a noun in apposition to the antecedent: Mc 15:16, Gl 3:16, Ef 6:17, al.; constr. ad sensum: Jo 6:9, Cl 2:19, 1Tm 3:16, Ap 13:14, al.;
__(b) in number, constr. ad sensum: At 15:36, 2Pe 3:1;
__(with) in case, by attraction to the case of the antecedent (Bl., §50, 2): Jo 4:18, At 3:21, Rm 15:18, 1Co 6:19, Ef 1:8, al.
__3. The neut. ὅ with nouns of other gender and with phrases, which thing, which term: Mc 3:17 12:42, Jo 1:39, Cl 3:14, al.; with a sentence, At 2:32, Gl 2:10, 1Jo 2:8, al.
__4. With ellipse of a demonstrative (οὗτος or ἐκεῖνος), before or after: before, Mt 20:23, Lc 7:43, Rm 10:14, al.; after, Mt 10:38, Mc 9:40, Jo 19:22, Rm 2:1 al.
__5. Expressing purpose, end or cause: Mt 11:10 (who = that he may), Mc 1:2, Hb 12:6 al.
__6. C. prep, as periphrasis for conjc.: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ( = ἀντὶ τούτων ὧν), because, Lc 1:20, al.; wherefore, Lc 12:3; ἐξ οὗ, since, for that, Rm 5:12; ἀφ᾽ οὗ, since (temporal), Lc 13:25; ἐξ οὗ, whence, Fp 3:20; etc.
__7. With particles: ὃς ἄν (ἐάν), see: ἄν, ἐάν; ὃς καί, Mc 3:19, Jo 21:20, Rm 5:2, al.; ὃς καὶ αὐτός, Mt 27:57.
__8. Gen., οὗ, absol., as adv. (see: οὗ).
(AS)

G3740.def:
ὁσάκις
(ὅσος),
relat. adv.,
as often as: before ἐάν (which see), 1Co 11:25-26, Ap 11:6,†
(AS)

G3741.def:
ὅσιος, -ον
(so sometimes in cl., but most frequently -α, -ον), [in LXX chiefly for חָסִיד, also for טָהוֹר, יָשָׁר, תָּמִים ;]
religiously right, right­eous, pious, Holy: of men, Tt 1:8. Hb 7:26; by meton., ὁ. χεῖρας, 1Tm 2:8 (cf. Dt 32:4); of God, Ap 15:4 16:5; as subst., ὁ ὅ., of the Messiah, At 2:27 13:35" (LXX) ; τὰ ὅ. Δανεὶδ τ. πιστά (Field, Notes, 121), At 13:34 (LXX).†
SYN.: see: ἅγιος (cf. also DB, ii, 399.b; iv, 352.b, and ref. see word -ίως) (AS)

G3742.def:
ὁσιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ὅσιος), [in LXX: Dt 9:5 (יֹשֶׁר), 1Rs 14:41, 3Ki.9:4 (תֹּם, תָּמִים), Pv 14:32, Wis.2:22 5:19 9:3 14:30 * ;]
piety, holiness: assoc. with δικαιοσύνη, Lc 1:75, Ef 4:24.†
SYN.: see: ἅγιος (AS)

G3743.def:
ὁσίως
(ὅσιος),
adv., [in LXX: 3Ki.8:61, Wis.6:10 * ;]
piously, holily: ὁ. καὶ δικαίως κ. ἀμέμπτως (on the distinction here between these synonyms, see M, Th., 24 f.), 1Ts 2:10.†
(AS)

G3744.def:
ὀσμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὄζω), [in LXX chiefly for רֵיחַ ;]
a smell, odour: Jo 12:3; metaphorically (EV, savour), 2Co 2:14 2:16; of the effect of sacrifice (cf. נִיחוֹחַ רֵיחַ, Gn 8:21, al., see: εὐωδία), ὀ. εὐωδίας, Ef 5:2, Fp 4:18.†
(AS)

G3745.def:
ὅσος, -η, -ον,
correlat. of τοσοῦτος,
how much, how many, how great, how far, how long, as much as, etc. (= Lat. quantus);
__(a) of number and quantity: m. pl., Mt 14:36, Mc 3:10, Rm 2:12, al.; n. pl., Mt 17:12, Mc 10:21, Lc 11:8, al.; πάτνες (πάντα) ὅ., Mt 13:46, Lc 4:40, al.; before οὗτοι (ταῦτα), Rm 8:14, Fp 4:8; with indic., Mc 6:56, Ap 3:19; with subjc. Mc 3:28, al.; ὅ. ἄν, Mt 18:18, Jo 11:22, al.;
__(b) of measure and degree: Mc 3:8, Lc 8:39, At 9:13; in compar. sent., ὅσον before μᾶλλον, Mc 7:36; καθ᾽ ὅσον, with compar.. Hb 3:3; before τοσοῦτο, Hb 7:20; οὕτως, Hb 9:27; τοσαύτῳ, with compar. before ὅσῳ, with compar., Hb 1:4; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον, inasmuch as, Mt 25:40, 45 Rm 11:13;
__(with) of space and time: Ap 21:16; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον, as long as, Mt 9:15, 2Pe 1:13; ἐφ᾽ ὅ. χρόνον, Rm 7:1, 1Co 7:39, Gl 4:1; ἔτι μικρὸν ὅσον ὅσον, yet how very short a time, Hb 10:37 (LXX).
(AS)

G3747.def:
ὀστέον (Att.. contr. ὀστοῦν, -οῦ, and so Jo, l.with), -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for עֶצֶם ;]
a bone: contr., ὀστοῦν (see supr.), Jo 19:36 (LXX); uncontr. (as in Hom., Hdt.), ὀστέα, Lc 24:39; ὀστέων, Mt 23:27, Hb 11:22.†
(AS)

G3748.def:
ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅ τι (also written ὅ, τι and ὅτι; see LS, see word; WH, §411; Tdf., Pr., 111), in NT scarcely ever except in nom. (M, Pr., 91), the only instance of the oblique cases being found in ἕως ὅτου (see: ἕως), relative of indef. reference (related to simple ὅς as Lat. quisquis to qui),
whoever, anyone who;
__(a) of an indef. person or thing: in general statements, Mt 5:39, 41 13:12, and freq., Lc 14:27, Gl 5:4, al.; in relative sentences, Mt 7:26, Lc 15:7, Fp 3:7, al.; πᾶς, with indic., Mt 7:24 10:32; ὅ ἄν (ἐάν), with subjc., Mt 12:50 13:12, Jo 14:13, 1Co 16:2, Gl 5:10, al.;
__(b) of a definite person or thing, indicating quality, "either generic, which, as other like things, or essential, which by its very nature" (Hort on 1Pe 2:11), who is such as: Mt 2:6 7:26, Lc 2:10 7:37, Jo 8:53, At 7:53, Rm 6:2, 1Co 3:17, Gl 4:24, Ef 1:23, al.;
__(with) where the relative sentence expresses a reason, consequence, etc. (M, Pr., 92), seeing that he (it, they), and he (it, they): Lc 8:3 10:42, At 10:47 11:28, Fp 4:3, al.;
__(d) as in Ionic and late Greek (Bl., §50, 1; M, Pr., l.with), differing but little from ὅς: Lc 2:4 9:30, At 17:10, Ap 12:13.
(AS)

G3749.def:
ὀστράκινος -η, -ον
(ὄστρακον, an earthen vessel or potsherd), [in LXX chiefly for חֶרֶשׂ ;]
made of clay, earthen: 2Co 4:7, 2Tm 2:20.†
(AS)

G3750.def:
ὄσφρησις, -εως, ἡ
(ὀσφραίνομαι, to smell),
the sense of smell, smell­ing: 1Co 12:17.†
(AS)

G3751.def:
ὀσφύς, -ύος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מֹתֶן;, also for חָלַץ, etc. ;]
the loin: Mt 3:4, Mc 1:6; metaphorically, περιζώννυσθαι (ἀναζ-) τ. ὀσφύας, Lc 12:35, Ef 6:14, 1Pe 1:13; regarded, as by the Hebrews, as the seat of generative power, Hb 7:5, 10; metaphorically, καρπὸς τ. ὀσφύος, At 2:30
(AS)

G3752.def:
ὅταν (for ὅτ᾽ ἄν = ὅτε ἄν),
temporal particle,
with a conditional sense, usually of things expected to occur in an indefinite future;
__1. prop., whenever;
__(a) (a) with subjc. praes.: Mt 6:2, 5 Mc 14:7, Lc 11:36, Jo 7:27, At 23:35, 1Co 3:4, al.; ἕως τ. ἡμέρας ἐκείνης, ὅ., Mt 26:29, Mc 14:25; before τότε, 1Ts 5:3;
__(b) with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 185): Mt 5:11, Mc 4:15, Lc 6:22, Jo 2:10 8:28 (Field, Notes, 94), 10:4, al.
__2. As in Hom. (LS, see word), but not in cl. prose, with indic., when (M, Pr., 167f.; Bl., §65, 9): with impf., Mc 3:11(cf. Gn 38:9, al.); with praes., Mc 11:25; with fut.. Ap 4:9 (Swete, in l.); with aor., Mc 11:19, Ap 8:1 (Swete, in ll.; M, Pr., 168, 248; Field, Notes, 35).
(AS)

G3753.def:
ὅτε, temporal particle (correlat. of πότε, τότε),
when; with indic., (so generally in cl., but also with optative, subjc.; LS, see word), most frequently with aor., Mt 9:25, Mc 1:32, Lc 4:25, Jo 1:19, At 1:13, Rm 13:11, Gl 1:15, Ap 1:17, al.; with impf., Mc 14:12, Jo 21:18, Rm 6:20, 1Ts 3:4, al.; with pf., since, now that, 1Co 13:11 (B, ἐγένομην); with praes., Mc 11:1, Jo 9:4, Hb 9:17, with fut. (Hom.; of a def. fut. as opposite to the indef. fut. of ὅταν with subjc.), Lc 17:22, Jo 4:21, 23 5:25 16:25, Rm 2:16 (T, txt., WH, mg.), 2Tm 4:3 (in all which instances, and with pres., Jo, l.with, ὅ. follows a subst. of time, and is equiv. to a rel. phrase, ἐν ᾧ or ᾗ).
(AS)

G3754G.def:
ὅτι,
conjc. (prop. neut. of ὅστις).
__I. As conjc, introducing an objective clause, that;
__1. after verbs of seeing, knowing, thinking, saying, feeling: Mt 3:9 6:32 11:25, Mc 3:28, Lc 2:49, Jo 2:22, At 4:13, Rm 1:13 8:38 10:9, Fp 4:15, Tg 2:24, al.; elliptically, Jo 6:46, Fp 3:12, al.
__2. After εἶναι (γίνεσθαι): defining a demonstr. or of person(s) pron., Jo 3:19 16:19, Rm 9:6, 1Jo 3:16 al.; with pron. interrog., Mt 8:27, Mc 4:41, Lc 4:36, Jo 4:22 al.; id. elliptically, Lc 2:49, At 5:4, 9, al.;
__3. Untranslatable, before direct discourse (ὅτι recitantis): Mt 7:23, Mc 2:16, Lc 1:61, Jo 1:20, At 15:1, Hb 11:18, al. (on the pleonastic ὡς ὅτι, see: ὡς).
__II. As causal particle, for that, because: Mt 5:4-12, Lc 6:20, 21, J0 1:30 5:27, At 1:5, 1Jo 4:18, Ap 3:10, al. mult.; διὰ τοῦτο ὅτι, Jo 8:47 10:17, al.; answering a question (διὰ τί), Rm 9:32, al.; οὐκ ὅτι . . . ἀλλ᾽ ὅτι, Jo 6:26 12:6.
(AS)

G3754H.def:
ὅτι,
conjc. (prop. neut. of ὅστις).
__I. As conjc, introducing an objective clause, that;
__1. after verbs of seeing, knowing, thinking, saying, feeling: Mt 3:9 6:32 11:25, Mc 3:28, Lc 2:49, Jo 2:22, At 4:13, Rm 1:13 8:38 10:9, Fp 4:15, Tg 2:24, al.; elliptically, Jo 6:46, Fp 3:12, al.
__2. After εἶναι (γίνεσθαι): defining a demonstr. or of person(s) pron., Jo 3:19 16:19, Rm 9:6, 1Jo 3:16 al.; with pron. interrog., Mt 8:27, Mc 4:41, Lc 4:36, Jo 4:22 al.; id. elliptically, Lc 2:49, At 5:4, 9, al.;
__3. Untranslatable, before direct discourse (ὅτι recitantis): Mt 7:23, Mc 2:16, Lc 1:61, Jo 1:20, At 15:1, Hb 11:18, al. (on the pleonastic ὡς ὅτι, see: ὡς).
__II. As causal particle, for that, because: Mt 5:4-12, Lc 6:20, 21, J0 1:30 5:27, At 1:5, 1Jo 4:18, Ap 3:10, al. mult.; διὰ τοῦτο ὅτι, Jo 8:47 10:17, al.; answering a question (διὰ τί), Rm 9:32, al.; οὐκ ὅτι . . . ἀλλ᾽ ὅτι, Jo 6:26 12:6.
(AS)

G3756.def:
οὐ, before a vowel with smooth breathing οὐκ, before one with rough breathing οὐχ (but improperly οὐχ ἰδού, At 2:7, WH, mg.; cf. WH, Intr., §409; M, Pr., 44, 244),
[in LXX for אֵין ,אַיִן ,לֹא ;]
neg. particle,
not, no, used generally with indic, and for a denial of fact (cf . μή);
__1. absol. (accented), οὔ, no: Mt 13:29 Jo 1:21 21:5; οὒ οὕ, Mt 5:37 Tg 5:12.
__2. Most frequently negativing a verb or other word, Mt 1:25 10:26, 38, Mc 3:25 9:37, Jo 8:29, At 7:5, Rm 1:16, Fp 3:3, al.; in litotes, οὐκ ὀλίγοι (i.e. very many), At 17:4, al.; οὐκ ἄσημος, At 21:39; πᾶς . . . οὐ, with verb, (like Heb. כֹּל . . . לֹא), no, none, Mt 24:22, Mc 13:20, Lc 1:37, Ef 5:5, al.; in disjunctive statements, οὐκ . . . ἀλλά, Lc 8:52 Jo 1:33 Rm 8:2o, al.; with 2 of person(s) fut. (like Heb. לֹא, with impf.), as emphatic prohibition, Mt 4:7, Lc 4:12, Rm 7:7, al.
__3. With another negative,
__(a) strengthening the negation: Mc 5:37, Jo 8:15 12:19, At 8:39, al.;
__(b) making an affirmative: At 4:20, 1Co 12:15.
__4. With other particles: οὐ μή (see: μή); οὐ μηκέτι, Mt 21:19; with μή interrog., Rm 10:18, 1Co 9:4, 5 11:22.
__5. Interrogative, expecting an affirmative answer (Lat. nonne): Mt 6:26, Mc 4:21, Lc 11:40, Jo 4:35, Rm 9:21, al.
(AS)

G3757.def:
oὗ
(prop. genitive of ὅς),
adv. of place, where, whither;
__(a) in answer to the question "where?" (= ubi): Mt 2:9 18:20, Lc 4:16-17 23:53, At 1:13 2:2 7:29 12:12 16:13 20:6, 8 25:10 28:14, Rm 9:26" (LXX), Cl 3:1, Hb 3:9" (LXX), Ap 17:15; of condition, Rm 4:15 5:20, 2Co 3:17;
__(b) in answer to the question "whither?" (= quo): Mt 28:16, Lc 10:1 24:28; before ἐάν, with subjc., 1Co 16:6.†
(AS)

G3759.def:
οὐαί
interj. of grief or denunciation, [in LXX for הוֹי, etc. ;]
alas! woe! most frequently with dative of person(s) Mt 11:21 23:14, Mc 13:17 14:21, Lc 6:24-26 Ju 11, al.; with vocat. (nom.), Ap 18:10, 16 18:19 (cf. Is 1:24, al.); with accusative, Ap 12:12, before ἐκ, Ap 8:13; with dative before ἀπό (see M, Pr., 246), Mt 18:7. As subst., 1Co 9:16 (cf. Jr 6:4); ἡ οὐ., Ap 9:12 11:14; pl., Ap 9:12; οὐ., οὐ., οὐ., Ap 8:13
(AS)

G3760.def:
οὐδαμῶς
(οὐδαμός, not even one),
adv., [in LXX: 2-4Mac.8* ;]
in no wise, by no means: Mt 2:6 (OT).†
(AS)

G3761.def:
οὐδέ, negative particle, related to μηδέ as οὐ to μή.

__I. As conjc., and not, also not, neither, nor: Mt 6:15, Lc 16:31, Rm 4:15, al.; οὐ . . . οὐδέ, Mt 5:15 10:24, Mc 4:22, Lc 6:43, 44, Jo 6:24, At 2:27, Rm 2:28, al. (see Bl., §77, 10).

__II. As adv., not even: Mt 6:29, Mc 6:31, Lc 7:9, 1Co 5:1; οὐδὲ εἷς, At 4:32, Rm 3:10" (LXX) .
(AS)

G3762.def:
οὐδείς, -δεμία, -δέν (also in WH, txt., the Hellenistic forms -θείς, -θέν, Lc 22:35 23:14, At 15:9 19:27 26:26, 1Co 13:2, 2Co 11:8; cf. BL, §6, 7; M, Pr., 56n, Thackeray, Gr., 58), related to μηδείς as οὐ to μή,
no, no one, none: with nouns, Lc 4:24, Jo 10:41, Rm 8:1, al.; absol., Mt 6:24, Mc 3:27, Lc 1:61, Jo 1:18, At 18:10, Rm 14:7, al. mult.; with genitive partit., Lc 4:26, Jo 13:28, al.; neut., οὐδέν, Mt 10:26, al.; id. with genitive partit., Lc 9:36, At 18:17, al.; οὐδὲν εἰ μή, Mt 5:13, Mc 9:29, al.; with neg., strengthening the negation, Mc 15:4, 5 Lc 4:2, Jo 3:27, al.; adverbially, At 25:10, Gl 4:12, al.
(AS)

G3764.def:
οὐδέπω
adv., [in LXX: Êx 9:30 (טֶרֶם)* ;]
not yet: Lc 23:53, Jo 7:39 19:41 20:9, At 8:16.†
(AS)

G3766.def:
οὐκοῦν
adv. (οὔκουν, not therefore),
with the negative element lost, therefore, so then: Jo 18:37.†
(AS)

G3767.def:
οὖν,
particle
expressing consequence or simple sequence (never standing first in a sentence), wherefore, therefore, then: Mt 3:10, Lc 3:9, Jo 8:38, At 1:21, Rm 5:9, al.; in exhortations, Mt 3:8, Lc 11:35, At 3:19, Rm 6:12, al.; in questions, Mt 13:28, Mc 15:12, Jhn.8:[5], Rm 6:1, al.; continuing a narrative or resuming it after a digression, Mt 1:17, Lc 3:18, Jo 1:22 2:18 (and very frequently in this Gospel), At 26:22, al.; ἄρα οὖν (see: ἄρα); ἐπεὶ οὖν, Hb 2:14; οὖν with ptcp. (= ἐπεὶ οὖν), At 2:30, Rm 5:1, al.; ἐὰν οὖν (where οὖν rather in sense belongs to the apodosis), Mt 5:23, Lc 4:7, Jo 6:62, Rm 2:26, al.; ὡς οὖν, Jo 4:1, al.
(AS)

G3768.def:
οὔπω
neg. adv. of time,
not yet: Mt 24:6, Mc 13:7, Jo 2:4 3:24 6:17, al.; with neg., Mc 11:2, Lc 23:53; interrog., Mt 16:9, Mc 4:40 8:17, 21
(AS)

G3769.def:
οὐρά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX for זָנָב ;]
a tail: Ap 9:10, 19 12:4.†
(AS)

G3770.def:
οὐράνιος, -ον
(cl. usually -α, -ον), [in LXX: Dt 28:12 A (שָׁמַיִם), etc. ;]
of or in heaven, heavenly: Mt 5:48 6:14, 26 6:32 15:13 18:35 23:9, Lc 2:13, At 26:19.†
(AS)

G3772.def:
οὐρανός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַיִם (hence, often pl., οἱ οὐ., see infr.) ;]
heaven;
__1. of the vault or firmament of heaven, the sky and the aerial regions above the earth: opposite to ἡ γῆ, Hb 1:10, 2Pe 3:5, 10; ὁ οὐ. καὶ ἡ γῆ, i.e. the world, the universe, Mt 5:18, Mc 13:31, Lc 10:21, At 4:24, Ap 10:6, al.; ἀπ᾽ ἄκρων οὐ. ἕως ἄ. αὐτῶν (on the absence of art. aft. prep., see Bl, §46, 5), Mt 24:31; ὑπὸ τὸν οὐ., At 2:5, Cl 1:23; ὑψωθῆναι ἕως τοῦ οὐ., figuratively, Mt 11:23, Lc 10:15; σημεῖον ἐκ τοῦ οὐ., Mt 16:1, Mc 8:11, al.; αἱ νεφέλαι, Mt 24:30, al.; τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐ., Mt 6:26, Mc 4:32, al.; οἱ ἀστέρες τοῦ οὐ., Ap 6:13, al.; pl. (οἱ) οὐ. (Bl., §32, 5), Mt 3:16, Mc 1:10, Jo 1:32, 2Pe 3:7, 13 al.
__2. Of the abode of God and other blessed beings: of angels, Mt 24:36, Mc 12:25, Gl 1:8, Ap 10:1, al.; of Christ glorified, Mrk.16:[19], Lc 24:51, At 3:21, Rm 10:6, al.; of God, Mt 5:34, Rm 1:18, al.; ὁ Πατὴρ ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐ. (Dalman, Words, 184ff.), Mt 5:16 6:1, al.; θησαυρὸς ἐν οὐ., Mt 6:20, Mc 10:21, al.
__3. By meton.,
__(a) of the inhabitants of heaven: Ap 18:20 (cf. ib. 12:12, Jó 15:15, Is 44:23);
__(b) as an evasive reference to God, characteristic of later Judaism (Dalman, Words, 204ff.): Mt 21:25, Mc 11:30, Lc 15:18, Jo 3:27, al.; ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐ. (= τοῦ Θεοῦ); see: βασιλεία).
βασιλεία, -ας, ἡ
(βασιλεύω), [in LXX chiefly for מַמְלָכָה ,מַלְכוּת ;]
__1. prop. abstract, sovereignty, royal power, dominion: Lc 1:33 22:29, Jo 18:36, At 1:6, Hb 1:8, 1Co 15:24; λαβεῖν β., Lc 19:12, 15 Ap 17:12; δοῦναι τὴν, ib. 17; ἔχειν β., ib. 18; ἔρχεσθαι ἐν τ. (εἰς τὴν) β., Mt 16:28, Lc 23:42; β. τ. θεοῦ, Ap 12:10.
__2. By meton., concrete (MM, Exp., x),
__(a) a kingdom, the territory or people over whom the king rules (Et 5:3, al.): Mt 4:8 12:25, 26 24:7, Mc 3:24 6:23, Lc 4:5, Hb 11:33, al.;
__(b) the royal majesty (cf. our phrase His Majesty), the king himself (τ. σπέρμα τῆς β., 4Ki.11:1).
__3. In LXX (Wis.6:5, Tob.13:1, al.), Targ. and NT, of the Messianic rule and kingdom, ἡ β. τ. θεοῦ, τ. οὐρανῶν (Heb. מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם, Aram. מַלְכוּתָא דִשׁמַיָּא; see Dalman, Words, 91-147; Cremer, 132, 658), the kingdom of God (on the equivalence of the two phrases, see Dalman, op. cit., 93, 218f.); τ. θεοῦ, Mt 6:33 12:28, al.; τ. οὐρανῶν, Mt 3:2 4:17, al.; τ. Χριστοῦ (מַלִכוּת דִמְשִׁיחא, Targ. Jon. on Is 53:10), Ef 5:5; τ. κυρίου, 2Pe 1:11, Ap 11:15; τ. Δαυείδ, Mc 11:10; absol., ἡ β., Mt 4:23, Tg 2:5, al. The kingdom is regarded as present: Mt 11:12, Lc 17:21, Rm 14:17, al.; as that which is to be consummated in the future, Mt 6:10, Mc 9:1, Jo 3:5, 2Pe 1:11, al. Noteworthy phrases are: ζητεῖν τὴν β., Mt 6:33; δέχεσθαι, Mc 10:15; κλρονομεῖν, Mt 25:34; διδόναι, Lk 12:32; παραλαμβάνειν, Hb 12:28; αὐτῶν (τοιούτων) εστὶν ἡ β., Mt 5:3, 10 19:14, Mc 10:14, Lc 18:16; διὰ τὴν β., Mt 19:12; ἕνεκεν τῆς β., Lc 18:29; εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, κηρύσσειν, διαγγέλλειν τὴν β., Lc 4:43 9:2, 60; ἤγγικεν ἡ β., Mt 3:2, Mc 1:15; κλεῖς τῆς β., Mt 16:10; κλείειν τὴν β., Mt 23:14; υἱοὶ τῆς β., Mt 8:12 13:38 (cf. Cremer, 132, 658).
\ (AS)

G3775.def:
οὖς genitive, ὠτός, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for אֹזֶן ;]
the ear: Mt 13:16, Mc 7:33, Lc 22:50, 1Co 2:9 12:16, 1Pe 3:12; ἐν τ. ὠσί, Lc 4:21; εἰς τ. ὦτα ἀκούεσθαι, At 7:57; γίνεσθαι, Lc 1:44; εἰσέρχεσθαι, Tg 5:4; εἰς τ. οὖς ἀκούειν, Mt 10:27; πρὸς τ. οὖς λαλεῖν, Lc 12:3; τὰ ὦ. συνέχειν (MM, xviii), At 7:57. Metaphorical, of understanding, perceiving, knowing: Mt 13:16; ὁ ἔχων (εἴ τις ἔχει) οὖς ἀκουσάτω, Ap 2:7, 11 2:17, 29 3:6, 13 13:9; ὁ ἔχων (ὃς ἔχει, εἴ τις ἔχει) ὦτα (ἀκούειν) ἀκουέτω, Mt 11:15 13:9, 43, Mc 4:9, 23 7:16 (R, mg.), Lc 8:8 14:35; τοῖς ὠ. βαρέως ἀκούειν, Mt 13:15 At 28:27" (LXX) ; ὦ. ἔχοντες οὐκ ἀκούειν, Mc 8:18; ὦ. τοῦ μὴ ἀκούειν, Rm 11:8; θέσθε εἰς τὰ ὦ., Lc 9:44; ἀπερίτμητος τοῖς ὠ., At 7:51.†
(AS)

G3776.def:
οὐσία, -ας, ἡ
(οὖσα, fem. part. of εἰμί), [in LXX: Tob.14:13, 3Ma.3:28 * ;]
substance, property: Lc 15:12-13.†
(AS)

G3777.def:
οὔτε
negative particle, related to μήτε as οὐ to μή,
and not, neither, nor: οὐδεὶς . . . οὔτε, Ap 5:4; οὐδὲ . . . οὔτε, Gl 1:12; οὔτε . . . καί, Jo 4:11; after a question with μή interrog., Tg 3:12; οὔτε . . . οὔτε, neither . . . nor, Mt 6:20, Mc 12:25, Jo 4:21, At 15:10, Rm 8:38-39, Gl 5:6, al
(AS)

G3778.def:
οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο, genitive, τούτου, ταύτης, τούτου,
[in LXX chiefly for זֹאת ,זֶה ;]
demonstr. pron. (related to ἐκεῖνος as hic to ille),
this;
__1. as subst., this one, he;
__(a) absol.: Mt 3:17, Mc 9:7, Lc 7:44, 45, Jo 1:15, At 2:15, al.; expressing contempt (cl.), Mt 13:55, 56, Mc 6:2, 3, Jo 6:42, al.; εἰς τοῦτο, Mc 1:38, Rm 14:9; μετὰ τοῦτο (ταῦτα; V. Westc. on Jo 5:1), Jo 2:12 11:7, al.;
__(b) epanaleptic (referring to what precedes): Mt 5:19, Mc 3:35, Lc 9:48, Jo 6:46, Rm 7:10, al.;
__(with) proleptic (referring to what follows): before ἵνα (Bl., §69, 6), Lc 1:43, Jo 3:19 (and freq.) 15:8, Rm 14:9, al.; before ὅτι, Lc 10:11, Jo 9:3o, At 24:14, Rm 2:3, al.; ὅπως, Rm 9:17; ἐάν, Jo 13:35;
__(d) special idioms: τοῦτο μὲν . . . τ. δέ (cl), partly . . . partly. Hb 10:33; καὶ τοῦτο (τοῦτον, ταῦτα), and that (him) too, Rm 13:11, 1Co 2:2, Hb 11:12; τοῦτ᾽ ἐστιν, Mt 27:46.
__2. As adj., with subst.;
__(a) with art.
__(α) before the art.: Mt 12:32, Mc 9:29, Lc 7:44, Jo 4:15, Rm 11:24, Ap 19:9, al.;
__(β) after the noun: Mt 3:9, Mc 12:16, Lc 11:31, Jo 4:13, At 6:13, Rm 15:28, 1Co 1:20, Ap 2:24, al.;
__(b) with subst. anarth. (with predicative force; Bl., §49, 4): Lc 1:36 2:2 24:21, Jo 2:11 4:54 21:14, 2Co 13:1.
(AS)

G3779.def:
οὕτως, rarely (Bl., §5, 4; WH, App., 146f.) οὕτω, adv.
(οὗτος), [in LXX chiefly for כֵּן ;]
in this way, so, thus;
__1. referring to what precedes: Mt 5:16 6:30, Mc 10:43 14:59, Lc 1:25 2:48 15:7, Jo 3:8, Rm 1:15, 1Co 8:12, al.; οὕτως καί, Mt 17:12, Mc 13:29, al.; pleonastically, resuming a ptcp. (cl.; see Bl., §74, 6), At 20:11 27:17.
__2. Referring to what follows: Mt 1:18 6:9, Lc 19:31, Jo 21:1, 1Pe 2:15; bef. quotations from OT, Mt 2:5, At 7:6, 1Co 15:45, Hb 4:4.
__3. C. adj. (marking intensity): Hb 12:21, Ap 16:18; similarly with adv., Gl 1:6 (cl.).
__4. As a predicate (Bl., §76, 1): Mt 1:18 9:33, Mc 2:1, 2 4:26, Rm 4:18 9:20, I Pe 2:15; οὕ ἔχειν (Lat. sic or ita se habere), At 7:1, al.; ἐκαθέζετο (as he was, without delay or preparation), Jo 4:6.
__5. In comparison, with correlative adv.: καθάπερ . . . οὕ., Rm 12:4, 5 al.; καθὼς . . . οὕ., Lc 11:30, al.; οὕ. . . . καθώς, Lc 24:24, al.; ὡς . . . οὕ., Rm 5:15, al.; οὕ . . . ὡς, Mc 4:26, al; ὥσπερ . . . οὕ., Mt 12:40, al.; οὕ. . . . οὕ., 1Co 7:7.
(AS)

G3780.def:
οὐχί
strengthened form of οὐ,
not;
__(a) in neg. sentences, not, not at all: Lc 1:60 12:51, Jo 13:10, al.;
__(b) more frequently in questions where an affirm. ans. is expected (Lat. nonne) : Mt 5:46-47, Lc 6:39, Jo 11:9, al.
(AS)

G3781.def:
ὀφειλέτης, -ου, ὁ
(ὀφείλω),
a debtor: with genitive (of the amount), Mt 18:24. Metaphorical, of obligation or duty in general, with reference to favours received or injury done, etc.: Mt 6:12, Rm 1:14 8:12 15:27, Gl 5:3; of sinners, in relation to God (= Heb. חַיָּב; cf. Sir (Hb 8:5) (6)), Lc 13:4.†
(AS)

G3782.def:
ὀφειλή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὀφείλω),
a debt: Mt 18:32; metaphorically, one's due: Rm 13:7, 1Co 7:3 (found also in π.; see Deiss., BS, 221; MM, xviii).†
(AS)

G3783.def:
ὀφείλημα, -τος, τό
(ὀφείλω), [in LXX: Dt 24:10 (מַשָּׁאָה), I Et 3:20, 1Ma.15:8 * ;]
that which is owed, a debt: Rm 4:4; metaphorically (as Aram. חוֺבָא חוֺב), of sin as a debt, Mt 6:12.†
(AS)

G3784.def:
ὀφείλω
[in LXX: Dt 15:2, Is 24:2 (נָשָׁה), Eze.18:7 (חוֹב), Wis.12:15, 20, al. ;]
to owe, be a debtor: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 18:28, Lc 7:41 16:7, Phm 18; id. with dative of person(s), Mt 18:28, Lc 16:5. Pass., to be owed, to be due: τ. ὀφειλόμενον, Mt 18:30, 34. Metaphorical: absol. (= Rabbinic חַיָּב; see McNeile, in l), Mt 23:16, 18; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Rm 13:8; with inf., to be bound or obliged to do (of. Westc., Epp. Jo., 50), Lc 17:10, Jo 13:14 19:7, At 17:29, Rm 15:1, 27, 1Co 5:10 7:36 9:10 11:7 11:10, 2Co 12:14, Ef 5:28, 2Ts 1:3 2:13, Hb 2:17 5:3, 12, 1Jo 2:6 Jn 3:16 Jn 4:11, 3Jn.8; ὤειλον συνίστασθαι, I ought to have been commended, 2Co 12:11. In peculiar Aram. sense of having wronged one (see: όφείλημα; but of. also Inscr. ἁμαρτίαν ὀφείίλω, Deiss., BS, 225), with dative of person(s), Lc 11:4 (cf. προσ-οφίελω).†
(AS)

G3785.def:
ὄφελον 2 aorist of ὀφείλω, without the augment (see M, Pr., 201n), used to express a fruitless wish;
[in LXX (with aor. indic.): Êx 16:3 (נָתַן מִי), Nm 14:2 Nm 20:3 (לוּא), Sl 119:5 (אַחֲלַי), etc. ;]
in cl. with an infin. (chiefly poët.),
would that: with indic. aor., 1Co 4:8; impf., 2Co 11:1, Ap 3:15; fut., Gl 5:12 (a practicable wish, see 131., 206 f., 220. The construction with indic. is only found in late writers.)†
(AS)

G3786.def:
ὄφελος, -ονς, τό
(ὀφέλλω, to increase) [in LXX: Jó 15:3 (יָעַל hi.)* ;]
advantage, help: 1Co 15:32, Tg 2:14, 16.†
(AS)

G3787.def:
ὀφθαλμο-δουλία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ὀφθαλμός, δοῦλος),
eye-service: Ef 6:6, Cl 3:22 (not found elsewhere).†
(AS)

G3788.def:
ὀφθαλμός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for עַיִן ;]
the eye (as in cl., chiefly pl.): Mt 5:38, Mc 9:47, Lc 6:41, Jo 9:6, al.; τοὺς ὀ. ἐξορύθσσειν (figuratively), Gl 4:15; ἐπᾶραι, Lc 6:20, Jo 6:5; ἀνοῖξα, At 9:40; id., of restoring sight, Mt 20:33, Jo 9:10, al.; ἐν ῥιπῇ ὀφθαλμοῦ, 1Co 15:52; by anthropom., of God, Hb 4:13, 1Pe 3:12; pleonastically (cf. Thackeray, Gr., 42f.), εἶδον οἱ ὀ. μοθ, Lc 2:30 (similarly, ib. 4:20 10:23, Jo 12:40, 1Co 2:9, 1Jo 1:1, Ap 1:7). Metaphorical (as otherwise in cl.; see LS, see word);
__(a) of ethical qualities: ὀ. πονηρός (meton., for envy; cf. Heb. עַיִן רַע, Pv 28:22; cf. Sir.14:10 34:13), Mt 6:22, 23 Mc 7:22, Lc 11:34; ἁπλοῦς, Mt 6:22, Lc 11:34; ἐπιθυμία (which see) ὀφθαλμῶν (cf. Ec 4:8, Sir.14:9), 1Jo 2:16; ὀ. μεστοὶ μοιχαλἰδος, 2Pe 2:14;
__(b) of mental vision: Mt 13:15, Mc 8:18, Lc 19:42, Jo 12:40, Rm 11:8, Gl 3:1, Ef 1:18, al.; ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς before genitive (on the absence of the art., seeBl, §46, 9.II; M, Pr., 81), Mt 21:42, Mc 12:11.
(AS)

G3789.def:
ὄφις, -εως, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נָחָשׁ ;]
a serpent, snake: Mt 7:10 Mc 16:18, Lc 10:19 11:11, Jo 3:14, 1Co 10:9, Ap 9:19; as typical of wisdom and cunning, Mt 10:16 23:23, 2Co 11:3 (cf. Gn 31:1-55); of Satan (cf. Gn 3:1, Wis.2:23-24, 4Ma.18:8), Ap 12:9, 14 12:11 20:2.†
(AS)

G3790.def:
ὀφρύς -ύος, ἡ
[in LXX: Lv 14:9 (עַיִן גַב) * ;]
an eyebrow, the brow of a hill: Lc 4:29.†
(AS)

G3791.def:
ὀχλέω, -ῶ
(ὄχλος), [in LXX: Tob.6:7, 3Ma.5:41 * ;]
to move, disturb; hence, generally, to trouble, vex: pass., At 5:6 (act. absol., = pass., to be in a tumult, 3Mac, l.with; cf. ἐν-, παρ-εν-οχλέω, and see MM, xviii).†
(AS)

G3792.def:
ὀχλο-ποιέω, -ῶ
to gather a crowd, make a riot: At 17:5 (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G3793.def:
ὄχλος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX for הָמוֹן (chiefly in Da TH), קָהָל ,חַיִל, etc. ;]
__1. a moving crowd or multitude of persons, a throng: Mt 9:23, Mc 2:4, Lc 5:1, Jo 5:13, al.; pl., Mt 5:1, Mc 10:1, Lc 3:7, and freq.; ὄ. ἱκανός, Mc 10:46, al.; τοσοῦτος, Mt 15:33; οὐ μετ᾽ ὄχλου, At 24:18; ἄτερ ὄχλου, Lc 22:6; πᾶς ὁ ὄ., Mt 13:2, Mc 2:13, al.; ὄ. πολύς, Mt 20:29, Mc 5:21, al.; ὁ πολὺς ὄ. (ὄ. π.), the populace, the common people, Mc 12:37 (Swete, in l.; Field, Notes, 37), Jo 12:9 (Westc, in l.).
__2. (As also cl., opposite to δῆμος, which see, and cf. Tr., Syn., §xcviii), the populace, the common people (cf. ὁ πολὺς ὄ., supr.), Mt 14:5 21:26, Mc 12:12, Jo 7:12b; so with contempt (cl.), Jo 7:49. In a more general sense, a multitude: with genitive, ὀνομάτων (see: ὀ.), At 1:15; μαθητῶν, Lc 6:17, al.
(AS)

G3794.def:
ὀχύρωμα, -τος, τό
(ὀχυρόω, to fortify, make firm), [in LXX for מִבְצָר, etc. ;]
a stronghold, fortress (Sl 89:40, Na 3:12, 14 al.); in LXX and NT, also metaphorically of that in which confidence is placed (Pv 10:29 21:22, al.): 2Co 10:4.†
(AS)

G3795.def:
ὀψάριον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of ὄψον, (1) cooked meat; (2) a relish or dainty, esp. fish, cf. MGr. τὸ ψάρι, fish; in comic poets and late prose writers only) [in LXX: Tob.2:2 א (Β, ὄψον)* ;]
fish: Jo 6:9, 11 21:9-10, 13 †
(AS)

G3796.def:
ὀψέ, adv. of time
[in LXX: Gn 24:11, Êx 30:8 (עֶרֶב, עֶרֶב בֵּין), Jr 2:23; τὸ ὀ., Is 5:11 (נֶשֶׁף)* ;]
__1. long after, late.
__2. late in the day, at evening (opposite to πρωί); in late writers used almost as an indecl. noun (see MM, xviii): Mc 11:11, 19 13:35.
__3. C. genitive, late in or on; and, in late writers also after (M, Pr., 72 f.), a sense which seems to be required in Mt 28:1.†
(AS)

G3797.def:
ὄψιμος, -ον
(ὀψέ), [in LXX: Dt 11:14, Pv 16:15, Os 6:4 (3), Jl 2:23, Zc 10:1, Jr 5:24 (מַלְקוֹשׁ), Êx 9:32 (אָפִיל)* ;]
poët. and late for ὄψιος, late: ὑετὸς ὄ.,
the latter rain (see DB, see word "rain"), with ellipsis of ὑετός (see WM, 740), Ja 57.†
(AS)

G3798.def:
ὄψιος, -α, -ον
(ὀψέ),
late: ἡ ὥρα, Mc 11:11 (Rec., WH, mg.). In late writers, ἡ ὀψία (sc. ὥρα), as subst., evening
[in LXX: Jdth.13:1*]:
Mt 8:16 14:15, 23 16:2 20:8 26:20 27:57, Mc 1:32 4:35 6:47 14:17 15:42, Jo 6:16 20:10.†
(AS)

G3799.def:
ὄψις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מַרְאֶה ;]
__1. the act of seeing, the sense of sight.
__2. face, countenance: Jo 11:44, Ap 1:16.
__3. appear­ance: κατ᾽ ὄ. κρίνειν (see MM, xviii), Jo 7:24.†
(AS)
